components.note: Public documentation, repository checker, unit tests and CI configuration; not FPGA verification.

XC7Z100 JTAG, a vendor LED smoke test, diagnostic GE ARP receive/reply, and two direct camera-bitstream ARP replies after power cycles were observed. Physical package/speed grade, full board bring-up and independent reproduction remain open.

A vendor OV5640 bitstream replied to ARP directly after two power cycles. One 300-second run assembled 7884 complete 640x480 frames; a second 10-second run assembled 262. Earlier ARP startup failure remains unexplained. Formal frame quality, own PL processing and independent reproduction remain open.

Original PL DVP adapter and frame red-statistics path passed targeted xsim tests, full synthesis/implementation, 100 same-frame board/software comparisons with zero mismatches, and a separate 30-second 899-frame receive run. The color rule is scene-dependent; inherited I/O timing gaps and independent reproduction remain open.

components.note: Optional 5-of-9 majority has small-scene and exact full-frame xsim evidence. After the user's later physical-ready confirmation and guarded controller selection, previous-camera and candidate configuration succeeded with EOS and both DONE fields 1. Candidate version 2 passed 100 exact same-frame statistics comparisons, all with no valid filtered target. The visible viewer received 1800 complete frames in 60.078 seconds at about 30 FPS, with 1 incomplete frame and 1 malformed datagram. Positive-target and interference acceptance remain open because the red paper was dim. Simulation status is retained until that broader board gate is met. Independent reproduction requires matching the recorded verifier source hashes.

Candidate RGB565 count, box and centroid reference checked on synthetic cases, two private raw camera frames at different exposures, and 100 same-frame board PL outputs. Broader lighting/background calibration remains open.
